test_summary.early_reselection: 6/6 bounded reference/candidate controls across preserve settings, LTR

chosen_bounded_behavior: For preserve=false, a canceled old phase does not destroy the reselected view; the live view is destroyed once after the latest valid departure completion or its fallback. Preserve=true retains the view. On early reselection the candidate reuses the live view.
historical_difference: Tagged Material 16.2.14 destroyed the old view during an interrupted cross, retained its original physical DOM nodes through five seconds and reselection, and created a second view. Candidate destruction/resource overlap and node identity therefore differ. No exact parity or owner waiver is asserted.
timing_limit: The monotonic early-end filter rejects obviously early old events but does not identify native event cycles. Repeated reversals, CSS restart failure, timer throttling and event-loop delays preclude a strict wall-clock bound.
limitations: Reference and candidate instrumented bundles were diagnostic copies, not goldens.

Archive retains receipts, exact source/test/diffs and recorded instrumented diffs, but deliberately omits large package, runtime and test-bundle bytes; their recorded original scratch locations are not durable.
